issue.title: Fix interruption of markAllocationIdAsInSync

labels.name: :Distributed/Recovery
labels.description: Anything around constructing a new shard, either from a local or a remote source.

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
`IndexShard#markAllocationIdAsInSync` is interruptible because it may
block the thread on a monitor waiting for the local checkpoint to
advance, but we lost the ability to interrupt it on a recovery
cancellation in #95270.

Closes #96578
Closes #100589
